Package edu.uky.cs.nil.sg

Class NumericValue

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.NumericValue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Value, Comparable<Value>
public class NumericValue extends Object implements Value
Numeric values represent numbers and are singleton objects that exist in all story graphs without needing to be explicitly defined in the value list.

  • Method Details

    • get

      public static final NumericValue get(Object object)
      Converts the given object into a singleton numeric value, if possible. Null is converted into Double.NaN. The Java number classes Integer and Double are converted via their Number.doubleValue() method. Other objects are converted by attempting to parse the output of their toString() method as a double.

      Numeric values are singletons, meaning that if this method is called more than once with an input that would be converted to the same number then the same numeric value object is returned every time.

      Parameters:
      object - the object to be converted to a numeric value
      Returns:
      a singleton numeric value
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the value cannot be converted to a numeric value
